scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:ai: cd apps/ai-engine && source venv/bin/activate && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 5000
scripts.setup:ai: cd apps/ai-engine && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n docker,web,api -c magenta,blue,green "docker-compose up" "sleep 5 && npm run dev:web" "sleep 5 && npm run dev:api"
